title: Catalog definitions changed
description: A tooling report brought, for approved tools, definitions that differ from their pinned ones, or, for models with a pinned digest, digests that differ from it (RFC-0002, sections 7.1 and 9; plan P1-16, step 2). The pinned definition or digest stays, and the reported one waits for review: enforcement points deny the tool or the model, and hide the tool, until it is approved (CORE-10). Each change carries both hashes, or both digests, and names its entry by key and by the SHA-256 of its reference, never by a reference in clear, a description or a schema (NFR-20, CORE-11). An event lists at most 100 changes: a report that brings more records several.

agent_id.description: The agent whose report brought the changes.

reference_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the string form of the entry's reference (contracts, section 4.10).

reported_definition.description: The definition hash that the report brought.

reported_digest.description: The digest that the report brought.

digest.description: A digest of a model's weights, as its runtime reports it: at most 128 bytes, without a control character.
